name: task-breaker
description: Turn an already-written dev task into a working task board for the current session only (the board does NOT persist once the session ends, nor across concurrent sessions) — organize it, break it into ordered tasks, execute them for real, see the whole board, get the single next step, and mark it done. The task-bar toggle also switches on an exclusive mode: while on, prompts inside this project that don't look board-related get blocked until turned off.
